title: Buildings
description: Constraints for building footprint features: Polygon geometry with required socio-economic and population lookup properties.

properties.description: residents_in_statistical_unit and living_area_m2_statistical_unit are optional: if omitted, supply a 'statistical_units' FeatureCollection and the values will be joined automatically.

children_under_10.description: Number of children under 10 years (sensitivity indicator C)

elderly_singles_over_65.description: Number of elderly singles over 65 years (sensitivity indicator ES)

social_welfare_recipients.description: Number of social welfare recipients (coping capacity indicator WR)

no_highschool_diploma.description: Number of residents without high-school diploma in last 3 years (coping capacity indicator EDQ)

statistical_unit_id.description: Reference key linking building to a statistical unit

residents_in_statistical_unit.description: Total residents registered in the statistical unit

living_area_m2_statistical_unit.description: Total residential floor area [m²] of the statistical unit
